pages.text: In a cozy burrow beneath a big oak tree, there lived a little bunny named Benny. Benny had the softest white fur, the longest floppy ears, and the biggest, brightest eyes in all the meadow. But there was one thing Benny didn't have - courage.

Benny was afraid of almost everything. He was scared of the dark, scared of thunder, and especially scared of the deep forest beyond the meadow. "The forest is too big and too scary," Benny would say, shaking his little cotton tail.

One day, Benny's little sister Lily hopped too far while chasing butterflies and got lost in the deep forest! "Help! Help!" her tiny voice echoed through the trees. Benny's heart raced with worry. His sister needed him!

Taking a deep breath, Benny hopped toward the forest. His legs trembled, but he kept going. "I must be brave for Lily," he told himself. Step by step, hop by hop, Benny entered the scary forest for the very first time.

Inside the forest, Benny met a wise old owl named Oliver. "Little bunny, why do you look so scared?" Oliver asked kindly. "I'm looking for my sister," Benny said bravely. "She's lost somewhere in here." Oliver smiled and pointed the way with his wing.

Following Oliver's directions, Benny hopped over logs, crossed a tiny stream, and pushed through the bushes. Finally, he found Lily sitting by a big mushroom, crying softly. "Benny!" she squealed with joy. "You came to save me!"

Benny hugged his little sister tight. Together, they hopped back home as the sun set behind the trees. From that day on, Benny wasn't scared anymore. He learned that being brave doesn't mean you're not afraid - it means doing what's right even when you are scared. The End.
